# QR Code Generator

`qrcode-generator.js` is the unmodified `dist/qrcode.mjs` from the MIT-licensed
[`qrcode-generator` 2.0.4](https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator) npm release,
renamed to `.js` so the existing static server serves its module MIME type.

Source archive: https://registry.npmjs.org/qrcode-generator/-/qrcode-generator-2.0.4.tgz

SHA-256 of the vendored file:
`ea91d7118a5395289170da848b7c6758b996163bfbccf312591ab65a4911b7c0`

The browser generates the connection QR locally. No identity is sent to an external
QR service. The license header is preserved in the source; the license text is in
`LICENSE.qrcode-generator.txt`.
